properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Bastion hosts that do not use the Standard SKU. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7) for administrative access. Standard SKU enables session recording, native client support, shareable links, and IP-based connection features required for privileged access management and audit trails.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Bastion deployment without Standard SKU. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
